endpoints.name: Get SO
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of an existing sales order. You provide the unique sales order ID. Requires SO_VIEW. Orders in read-only location groups are returned; 403 is only raised when the user has no access to the order's location group at all. Kit components are returned nested in a kitItems list on their parent kit item, not as top-level line items.

endpoints.name: Create SO
endpoints.description: Creates a sales order and returns it. Customer defaults (carrier, payment terms, currency, tax rate, addresses) are applied automatically from the selected customer. Kit items and drop ship items are NOT supported and return 422. Several fields are access-right gated and return 403 without the right: number (SO_EDIT_SO_NUM), salesperson other than yourself (SO_EDIT_SALESPERSON), paymentTerms other than the customer default (SO_PAYMENT_TERMS), soItems[].unitPrice and any Discount line (SO_PRICE_OVERRIDE).

SO_PRICE_OVERRIDE is a hard prerequisite for both. Missing rights return 403. Sale lines are stored positive, Credit Return lines negative.

endpoints.name: Get TO
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of an existing transfer order. You only need to provide the unique transfer order ID.

endpoints.name: Create TO
endpoints.description: Creates a new transfer order in Entered status. The type field decides which fields matter: Ship orders require shipFromAddress and shipToAddress; Move orders ignore address fields entirely. At least one line item is required. Access rights, location group access, and status rules are enforced.

endpoints.name: Issue TO
endpoints.description: Transitions a transfer order from Entered to Issued. Issuing triggers pick creation. Returns 404 if the transfer order is not found.

endpoints.name: Unissue TO
endpoints.description: Transitions a transfer order from Issued back to Entered. Unissuing REMOVES associated picks and receipts. Only the owner location group can unissue. Returns 404 if the transfer order is not found.

endpoints.name: Delete TO
endpoints.description: Deletes the transfer order with the specified ID. Only orders in Entered status with all line items in Entered status can be deleted. Returns 404 if the transfer order is not found.

endpoints.name: Next TO Number
endpoints.description: Returns the next available transfer order number. WARNING: calling this CONSUMES the number — the counter advances whether or not you go on to create an order. Added after 26.6 — returns 404 on older servers.

endpoints.name: Update TO
endpoints.description: Updates an existing transfer order. The toItems list is authoritative — any existing items not included in the request are deleted. Type and location groups can only be changed while the order is in Entered status. lastModified.dateLastModified is required for optimistic locking and must match the value returned by GET /transfer-orders/{id}. unitCost on toItems is honored only for non-inventory or shipping parts on Ship-type transfer orders (added 26.9); it is forced to zero for inventory parts and for Move-type orders. On an eligible item, omitting unitCost preserves the existing value; send an explicit value to change it, or 0 to clear it.

attributes.description: The transfer order ID. If provided, must match the ID in the URL.

attributes.description: Optimistic-locking token. Must match the current dateLastModified returned by GET /transfer-orders/{id}.

attributes.name: lastModified.dateLastModified

attributes.description: The destination location group. Can only be changed while in Entered status.

attributes.description: The complete list of transfer order items. Items not included are deleted. At least one item is required.

attributes.description: The existing item ID. Omit or set to 0 to add a new item.

attributes.name: toItems[].quantity
attributes.description: The quantity to transfer. Must be greater than zero.

attributes.name: toItems[].note
attributes.description: A note on the line item.

attributes.name: toItems[].unitCost
attributes.description: The unit cost. Honored only for non-inventory or shipping parts on Ship-type orders (added 26.9); forced to zero for inventory parts and for Move-type orders.

attributes.name: toItems[].dateScheduled
attributes.description: The scheduled fulfillment date for this item.

endpoints.name: Request TO
endpoints.description: Transitions a transfer order from Entered to Request status, signalling the receiving party to fulfil it. Requesting is only permitted for users with access to the owner location group but NOT both location groups — users with access to both should issue the order directly. Added in 26.9 — returns 404 on older servers.

endpoints.name: Unrequest TO
endpoints.description: Transitions a transfer order from Request back to Entered, cancelling the request before the receiving party has issued it. The order must be in Request status. Only the owner location group can unrequest — a user with access to both, or to only the non-owner location group, cannot. Added in 26.9 — returns 404 on older servers.

endpoints.name: Close Short TO
endpoints.description: Completes a partially fulfilled transfer order. The order must be in Picking, Partial, Picked, or Shipped status. Close-short voids unfulfilled line items, marks partially fulfilled lines as Closed Short, and sets the order status to Closed Short. All line items must be received first: an order with items still in transit (shipped but not received) cannot be closed short, and a partially fulfilled item must have its picked quantity fully received. Any Entered or Packed shipments and committed pick items must be voided first, and no line items may be in Picking or Picked status. Added in 26.9 — returns 404 on older servers.

endpoints.name: Void TO
endpoints.description: Transitions an Issued transfer order to Void status. Voiding voids all associated pick items, sets all line item statuses to Void, sets the order status to Void, and deletes any receipts. Only orders in Issued status can be voided.

endpoints.description: Changes a shipment's status from "Entered" to "Packed". This prepares the shipment for shipping but does not complete the shipment. Only shipments in "Entered" status can be packed. The operation automatically generates a shipment number and bill of lading if not already present.

endpoints.name: Ship Shipment

Shipments in either "Entered" or "Packed" status can be shipped — "Entered" shipments are automatically packed before shipping. Returns a 400 error if the shipment has already been shipped.

endpoints.name: Void Shipment
endpoints.description: Voids a shipment in "Packed" or "Shipped" status, reverting it back to "Entered". Packed shipments are reset to "Entered". Shipped shipments perform the existing rollback flow, which can restore inventory and remove unposted accounting data when supported. Returns a 400 error when the shipment cannot be voided.

endpoints.name: Export Data
endpoints.description: Export data as CSV or JSON. Set the "Accept" header to either text/csv or application/json. NAME FORMAT: Title-Case every word and join with hyphens, e.g. Bill-Of-Materials-Details, Quick-Books-Class, Units-Of-Measure. Fishbowl resolves the name twice: it strips the hyphens to find the importer (so BillOfMaterialsDetails still gets 500 "Missing access right entry") and turns them into spaces to find the access right (so Bill-of-Materials-Details gets 404 "not found" because the right is named Bill Of Materials Details). Casing is exact, including Of / And / As. The Name box lists every valid name.

Casing is exact, including Of / And / As. The Name box lists every valid name.

endpoints.name: Import
endpoints.description: Import data into Fishbowl. Pick the import type, then drop a file in or type/paste the rows - the first row is the header row. One endpoint, two wire formats: the CSV / JSON toggle below switches between them and converts whatever you have already typed, so nothing is retyped. CSV sends Content-Type text/plain; JSON sends application/json as an array of row arrays. Prefer JSON where a value may contain a comma, a quote or a NEWLINE - those tear a CSV row apart, and a two-line street address is the usual way an import dies with a messageless 500. NAME FORMAT: Title-Case every word and join with hyphens, e.g. Bill-Of-Materials-Details, Quick-Books-Class, Units-Of-Measure. Fishbowl resolves the name twice: it strips the hyphens to find the importer (so BillOfMaterialsDetails still gets 500 "Missing access right entry") and turns them into spaces to find the access right (so Bill-of-Materials-Details gets 404 "not found" because the right is named Bill Of Materials Details). Casing is exact, including Of / And / As. The Name box lists every valid name.
